beats.say: India's Andaman Islands are closer to Myanmar than to mainland India.
beats.cap: Closer to Myanmar than to India

beats.say: Port Blair is about twelve hundred kilometres from Chennai.
But Myanmar's Coco Islands are just twenty kilometres from the northern tip.
Why? These islands are the peaks of an underwater mountain range.
It starts in Myanmar, dives under the sea, and rises again as the Andamans.
Follow it south, and it bends towards Indonesia.
India's southern tip, Indira Point, is far closer to Sumatra than to the mainland.
So these islands guard the gate to the Malacca Strait.
So the closest neighbour to India's islands isn't mainland India.
